label: sports
name: Sports Image Category Classification
description: Classify a non-OCR sports image into one or more detailed categories based on the visible sport, athletes, equipment, playing environment, and physical activity.

labels.football: An image primarily showing football or soccer players, a football field, goalposts, or football action.
labels.cricket: An image primarily showing cricket players, batting, bowling, wickets, or a cricket ground.
labels.basketball: An image primarily showing basketball players, a basketball court, hoop, or basketball action.
labels.tennis: An image primarily showing tennis players, rackets, a net, or a tennis court.
labels.badminton: An image primarily showing badminton players, rackets, shuttlecocks, or a badminton court.
labels.volleyball: An image primarily showing volleyball players, a net, or volleyball action on an indoor or outdoor court.
labels.hockey: An image primarily showing field hockey or ice hockey players, sticks, goals, or hockey action.
labels.baseball: An image primarily showing baseball players, bats, gloves, bases, or a baseball field.
labels.swimming: An image primarily showing people swimming in a pool, open water, or a swimming competition.
labels.athletics: An image primarily showing running, jumping, throwing, or track-and-field competition.
labels.cycling: An image primarily showing people riding bicycles in a race, sport, or training activity.
labels.motorsport: An image primarily showing competitive car or motorcycle racing on a track or racing course.
labels.combat_sports: An image primarily showing boxing, wrestling, martial arts, or another combat sport.
labels.gymnastics: An image primarily showing gymnasts performing floor routines, balance, bars, rings, or vault exercises.
labels.golf: An image primarily showing golfers, golf clubs, golf balls, or a golf course.
labels.table_tennis: An image primarily showing table tennis players, paddles, a net, or a table tennis match.
labels.running: An image primarily showing a person running, jogging, racing, or participating in a marathon.
labels.gym_and_fitness: An image primarily showing exercise, weight training, fitness activity, or people using gym equipment.
labels.winter_sports: An image primarily showing skiing, snowboarding, ice skating, or another sport performed on snow or ice.
labels.water_sports: An image primarily showing surfing, kayaking, rowing, diving, or another sport performed in or on water.
